summary: This BCP gives IANA revised guidance for managing values in the fields of IGMP and MLD protocol headers. It sets how new values are assigned in these group management protocols. It obsoletes RFC 3228.

eli5.summary: When many people want to add names to a shared list, someone needs rules. This tells the list keeper how to hand out new codes for multicast group protocols.

questions: how are igmp and mld values assigned
